name: Birth Control
overview: Scripture affirms the blessing and command from God to be fruitful and multiply, as seen in Genesis 1:28, emphasizing the divine intention for procreation. Children are described as a heritage and reward from the Lord (Psalms 127:3), underscoring their sacred value. The account in Genesis 38:8 highlights the responsibility to raise up offspring within the family line, while Luke 23:29 acknowledges a future time when barrenness will be paradoxically regarded as blessed, signaling a departure from God's original design. Together, these verses frame birth control within the context of honoring God's purpose for life and fruitfulness.
